record.paper_title: Mapping Class Group Factorizations and Symplectic 4-Manifolds: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For a Lefschetz fibration f with total space M, and for the corresponding blown-down symplectic 4-manifold X when distinguished sections are used, which homology classes in H_2(M,Z) or H_2(X,Z) can be represented by Lagrangian spheres that arise from matching paths?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let f: M → S² (or D²) be a Lefschetz fibration with total space a smooth/symplectic 4-manifold M, with regular fiber a closed oriented surface Σ and a finite set of critical values with associated vanishing cycles in Σ. Recall that a matching path is an embedded arc γ in the base joining two critical values whose vanishing cycles are isotopic (in Σ) along γ; from such a path one obtains an embedded Lagrangian sphere S(γ) ⊂ M built as the union of the two vanishing thimbles along γ. When f admits a distinguished system of sections so that one can blow them down to obtain a closed symplectic 4-manifold X (with M = X # k·CP²-bar realized as the blow-up at the base points of a Lefschetz pencil on X), the matching-path spheres also give rise to Lagrangian spheres in X.

Characterize, for every Lefschetz fibration f as above, which homology classes A ∈ H₂(M; ℤ) can be represented by Lagrangian spheres arising from matching paths in the base of f, and analogously which classes A ∈ H₂(X; ℤ) can be represented by Lagrangian spheres arising from matching paths under the blow-down to X.
artifact.status_search_result: The classification of homology classes representable by matching-path Lagrangian spheres in Lefschetz fibrations and their blow-downs is a recognized open question in symplectic 4-manifold topology. Matching paths are a standard source of Lagrangian spheres (Auroux, Donaldson, Seidel), and partial results exist (e.g. for specific fibrations and via Lagrangian matching invariants by Perutz, Lekili), but a general characterization of which H₂ classes can be realized is not established in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Lefschetz fibrations in symplectic topology (Seidel)
status_evidence.snippet: Matching paths give rise to Lagrangian spheres in the total space of a Lefschetz fibration; understanding which homology classes arise is part of the broader program.
status_evidence.claim: Matching paths produce Lagrangian spheres but the characterization of represented homology classes is not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Broken Lefschetz Fibrations, Lagrangian matching invariants (Lekili)
status_evidence.snippet: Lagrangian matching invariants count multisections related to matching paths; only partial results about realizability of classes are known.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress; no general classification of matching-path sphere homology classes is given.
